title: Invest Gulf
summary: Independent research on property across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain and Oman: freehold zones and foreign ownership rules, off-plan escrow and payment plans, service charges and net yields by district, golden visa thresholds, and named developments. Not an agency, not a listings portal.
entity: Invest Gulf is an independent research publisher on Gulf property for foreign buyers, part of the MORE Group network. It sells no listings and represents no developer. Wikidata: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q140471703
